## Problem statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Is your feature request related to a workflow that's currently painful or impossible? Please describe.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. UI sketches, API shapes, or pseudo-code welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

- Who benefits from this feature (CTO, dev, PM, QA, compliance...)?
- Does it touch one of the 3 pillars (Confiance / Contrôle / Transparence)?
- Any related external tools, papers, or prior art?
